panels.title: Net closed P&L (verified cycles / selected scope)
panels.description: Fixed KPI window; only fully reconciled flat-to-flat cycles. Bot scope requires proven ownership. Transfers are not profit; net already includes fees/funding.

panels.title: Profitable cycles
panels.description: Fixed KPI window; only fully reconciled flat-to-flat cycles. Bot scope requires proven ownership. Transfers are not profit; net already includes fees/funding.

panels.title: Reconciled cycles (N, includes breakeven)
panels.description: Fixed KPI window; only fully reconciled flat-to-flat cycles. Bot scope requires proven ownership. Transfers are not profit; net already includes fees/funding.

panels.title: Profit factor (undefined if no losses)
panels.description: No invented finite PF. Check no-loss status below; N=0 gives unknown.

panels.title: Open positions / selected scope
panels.description: Complete Bybit position snapshot; bot is proven subset. A failed snapshot retains previous as-of and never means zero positions.

panels.title: Selected KPI window covered (1 yes / 0 partial)
panels.description: Time picker controls observed charts; KPI windows are all/UTC day/7d/30d. Unknown cycles stay excluded even if endpoints are covered.

panels.title: Account equity and wallet history (USDT)
panels.description: Actual ~60s observations, no reconstructed history. Deposits change balances and are not trading profit.

panels.title: Cumulative net profit of verified closed cycles
panels.description: Covered journal, not lifetime account profit. Corrections can revise the gauge; fees are not deducted twice.

panels.title: Watchlist
panels.description: Counts from the actual strategy pass, never a simulated second evaluation. Check strategy age; a waiting 5s loop is not a new candle.
